Commissioned by the Bundesstelle fur Energieeffizienz (BfEE) at the Bundesamt fur Wirtschaft und Ausfuhrkontrolle (BAFA), Eschborn.

BACKGROUND ONLY - no extraction. What it is and why no data: Survey (n = 219 firms) and expert-interview study of ISO 50001 and EMAS energy management in German companies: target achievement, measures implemented, costs of operating the system, savings potential by energy intensity. Results are company-level shares, not technology-level numbers. What it does have: Company savings potential by energy intensity (Table 6, graphic); share of savings from investment (40-80%); EnMS operating costs by company size; rebound small.
